Brown.UnstableThresholdHelp: Brown particles trigger when stability is below this threshold.
Brown.UnstableFinishThresholdHelp: Hard cap. If stability goes below this value, brown particle intensity will NOT increase further.
Brown.SpawnMultiplierHelp: Main slider. Bigger = more brown particles around you.
Brown.SpawnExtraCapHelp: Safety limit. Stops the game from spawning too many at once.
Brown.BurstMultiplierHelp: How strong the little brown puffs are at the chosen spot. Bigger = thicker.
Brown.BurstExtraCapHelp: Safety limit for extra little brown puffs at the chosen spot.

Teal.StableThresholdHelp: Teal particles trigger when stability is above this threshold.
Teal.StableFinishThresholdHelp: Hard cap. If stability goes above this value, teal particle intensity will NOT increase further.
Teal.SpawnMultiplierHelp: Main slider. Bigger = more teal particles around you.
Teal.SpawnExtraCapHelp: Safety limit. Stops the game from spawning too many at once.
Teal.BurstMultiplierHelp: How strong the little teal puffs are at the chosen spot. Bigger = thicker.
Teal.BurstExtraCapHelp: Safety limit for extra little teal puffs at the chosen spot.
